title: outlook.com e-mail address smtp server error in Thunderbird on Android
creator: simon241
content: I have an outlook.com e-mail address which I can successfully use in Thunderbird for Desktop in both macOS and Windows 10 (different computers). However, when I try to access that same e-mail account in Thunderbird for Android on both my Android tablet and my Android mobile phone. I get an error message 'Checking outgoing server settings failed' and 'SmtpClientAuthentication is disabled for the Mailbox. I managed to get through to a Microsoft agent who said I should contact Mozilla as the e-mail box was working ok on the two desktops so their settings are ok (but he would say that, wouldn't he!) Any help is appreciated. Thanks, Simon
